description: This Java class implements a message mapper for normalized changes within the Eclipse Ditto project. It maps create- and modify-events to nested sparse JSON, and drops other signals and incoming messages. The class handles configuration for fields selection, maps Adaptable objects or ExternalMessages to ExternalMessages with JSON payloads, and incorporates message enrichment and filtering logic.

classes.name: NormalizedMessageMapper
classes.description: A final class that implements a message mapper for handling normalized change events by mapping them into nested JSON structures, primarily for create and modify events.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier string for this mapper, which is 'normalized'.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with provided settings, particularly setting up field selection based on the configuration property.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Overloaded method: one version drops all incoming messages, the other convertsAdaptable objects representing create or modify events into ExternalMessages.

methods.name: flattenAsThingChange
methods.description: Transforms an Adaptable representing a create or modify event into an ExternalMessage with a JSON payload reflecting the change.

methods.name: abridgeMessage
methods.description: Builds a JSON object containing essential information from the adaptable, excluding detailed payload data, for inclusion in the message.

methods.name: dittoHeadersToJson
methods.description: Converts DittoHeaders into a JSON object.

methods.name: isCreatedOrModifiedThingEvent
methods.description: Checks whether a given TopicPath corresponds to a create or modify event for a Thing.
